fhb-low-deposit.html: In Sep 2026, 50.3% of First Home Buyer mortgages approved across New Zealand (55.6% by dollar value, or $850m) had under a 20% deposit (+4.2 pts YoY).
fhb-low-deposit.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table C31, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Percentages & averages derived by HLF. Historical market statistics for general information only.

fhb-share.html: First Home Buyers accounted for 20.3% of all new NZ mortgage lending in Sep 2026 (2,667 home loans approved, average loan $574k; +1.1 pts YoY).
fhb-share.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table C31, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Percentages & averages derived by HLF. Historical market statistics for general information only.

investors.html: Property investors accounted for 17.7% of new NZ mortgage lending in Sep 2026 ($1.33B; -3.5 pts YoY), compared with 20.3% for First Home Buyers.
investors.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table C31, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Percentages & averages derived by HLF. Historical market statistics for general information only.

refinance.html: In Sep 2026, 2,772 Kiwi borrowers switched mortgage providers—totalling $1.73B, or 23.0% of all new lending (average loan switched: $624k).
refinance.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table C33, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Derived by HLF. Historical market statistics for general information only.

top-ups.html: In Sep 2026, 9,639 existing NZ homeowners topped up their mortgage—representing 46.4% of all new mortgage approvals by borrower count (average top-up: $100k).
top-ups.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table C33, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Derived by HLF. Historical market statistics for general information only.

settled-rates.html: Across settled new NZ mortgages in Sep 2026, borrowers achieved a weighted-average rate of 4.82% on 1-year fixed terms and 5.09% on 2-year fixed terms.
settled-rates.source_html: Source: RBNZ Table B30, © Reserve Bank of New Zealand. Historical market statistics for general information only.

rent-yield-pulse.html: NZ median private weekly rent stood at $595/wk in Aug 2026 (+0.8% YoY)—with regional medians at $650/wk in Auckland, $580/wk in Wellington, and $550/wk in Canterbury.
rent-yield-pulse.source_html: Source: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (Tenancy Services Rental Bond Data), licensed under CC BY 3.0 NZ. Derived by HLF. Historical market statistics only.

rental-bonds-supply.html: Tenancy Services recorded 13,062 newly lodged private rental bonds in Aug 2026, across 522,942 active private tenancies nationwide.
rental-bonds-supply.source_html: Source: Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment (Tenancy Services Rental Bond Data), licensed under CC BY 3.0 NZ. Derived by HLF. Historical market statistics only.

student-loan-servicing.html: The median NZ student loan balance stood at $18,301 as at Jun 2026 (+4.5% YoY), across New Zealand and overseas-based borrowers.
student-loan-servicing.source_html: Source: Inland Revenue — Student Loan Statistics (Jun 2026), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Historical statistics for general information only.

kiwisaver-first-home.html: 4,250 KiwiSaver members withdrew a combined $195.7m in Sep 2026 (+5.7% YoY) for a first-home purchase—equating to ~$73k of KiwiSaver funds per approved first-home mortgage.
kiwisaver-first-home.source_html: Source: Inland Revenue — KiwiSaver Withdrawal Statistics cross-referenced with RBNZ Table C31, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Derived by HLF. General information only.

kiwisaver-switches.html: 198,897 KiwiSaver members transferred their balance to a new KiwiSaver scheme provider in the year ended June 2026 (an average of 16,575 scheme switches per month).
kiwisaver-switches.source_html: Source: Inland Revenue — KiwiSaver Scheme Transfer Statistics (CC BY 4.0). Monthly average derived by HLF. General information only, not personalised KiwiSaver advice.
